model.rapid_shift_proxy: Available time = min(attack spacing, released-fretting gap + min(125ms, attack spacing)). Open notes/rests count; time holding a fretted chord does not count as free travel. Risk sums round(1000 * max(0, distance - 8*time)^2 / max(time, 0.0625)). This estimates transition difficulty, not measured hand speed or guaranteed comfort.
model.picking_proxy: Choose ascending/descending chord sweeps; minimize string travel and skipped-string effort. No alternate/economy picking convention is imposed or inferred.
model.shape_scope: Explicit drop-power and adjacent-string power shapes, CAGED major/common minor chord templates, and E/A minor-pentatonic fragments. Complete 2/3-NPS and arpeggio phrase recognition is not claimed.
model.search: Exact dynamic programming within the finite model. Priority tiers are compared lexicographically.
model.baseline: Physically admitted per-attack open-first, lowest-fret greedy mapping with nearest reachable anchor.
